question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

In order to maintain good governance, every government servant must be held _____ for his/her decisions.
solution:
The correct answer is '**accountable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**accountable**" means required to explain actions or decisions to someone. (जवाबदेह)
 
• Maintaining good governance involves ensuring that government servants are responsible for their decisions and actions.
 
• The other options: "**irresponsible**," "**flexible**," and "**unaccountable**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In order to maintain good governance, every government servant must be held accountable__ for his/her decisions.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Irresponsible (गैर जिम्मेदार)**: means not showing a proper sense of responsibility.
 
• **Flexible (लचीला)**: means capable of bending easily without breaking, or adaptable.
 
• **Unaccountable (गैर जवाबदेह)**: means not responsible for actions or decisions.
